```{r}

weather_cols <- c(                      
  "STATION", "DATE", "LATITUDE", "LONGITUDE", "ELEVATION",
  "TAVG", "TMAX", "TMIN",                # temperature core
  "PRCP",                                # daily precip depth
  "SNDP",                                # snow depth on ground
  "CLDD", "HTDD",                        # cooling / heating degree-days
  "DP01", "DP10", "DP1X",                # days ≥ 0.01 / ≥ 0.10 / ≥ 1 in
  "DX32", "DX70", "DX90",                # days ≥ 32 °F, 70 °F, 90 °F
  "DT32", "DT00",                        # days < 32 °F, < 0 °F
  "EMXT", "EMNT",                        # monthly record high / low
  "EMXP",                                # monthly record precip
  "FRSHTT"                               # fog-rain-snow-hail-thunder-tornado flags
)

all_stations <- stations %>%
  lapply(function(x) {
    x %>%
      mutate(across(everything(), as.character)) %>%
      select(any_of(weather_cols))  # Only keeps columns in weather_cols
  }) %>%
  bind_rows(.id = "STATION") %>%
  distinct(STATION, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    network = case_when(
      str_starts(STATION, "US1") ~ "COOP",
      str_starts(STATION, "GHCND") ~ "GHCN",
      str_detect(STATION, "K[A-Z]{3}") ~ "ASOS/AWOS",  # Airport stations (KXXX)
      TRUE ~ "Other"  # Everything else
    )
  )


#number data should actually be stay numbers. putting it back
num_cols <- c("LATITUDE", "LONGITUDE", "ELEVATION", "TAVG", "TMAX", "TMIN", "PRCP")
all_stations <- all_stations %>%
  mutate(across(any_of(num_cols), ~ {
    nums <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.))
    ifelse(is.finite(nums), nums, NA)  
  }))

# 2. Filter like a blue whale babey
stations_geo <- all_stations %>% 
  filter(
    !is.na(LATITUDE), 
    !is.na(LONGITUDE),
    between(LONGITUDE, -180, -50),  
    between(LATITUDE, 15, 72)       
  ) %>%
  arrange(STATION, desc(DATE)) %>%
  distinct(STATION, .keep_all = TRUE)

stations_sf <- stations_geo %>%
  st_as_sf(
    coords = c("LONGITUDE", "LATITUDE"),
    crs = 4326,
    remove = FALSE
  ) %>%
  st_make_valid()

```

```{r}
us_counties <- read_csv("~/Desktop/STAT155/stat-155-project/US_County_Boundaries.csv")
```
```{r}
counties_sf <- st_read(
  "~/Desktop/STAT155/stat-155-project/US_County_Boundaries/US_County_Boundaries.shp",
  quiet = TRUE
) %>%
  select(GEOID, geometry)   

```

```{r}

stations_sf <- stations_geo %>%
  st_as_sf(
    coords = c("LONGITUDE", "LATITUDE"),
    crs    = 4326,
    remove = FALSE
  )

# 3. Reproject stations to match counties
stations_sf <- st_transform(stations_sf, st_crs(counties_sf))

# 4. Now the join will work
stations_with_county <- st_join(
  stations_sf,
  counties_sf,
  join = st_within,
  left = FALSE
)


```

```{r}
station_list <- readRDS("~/Desktop/STAT155/stat-155-project/station_list.rds")

weather_all <- imap_dfr(station_list, function(df, st) {
  df %>%
    transmute(
      STATION = st,
      DATE    = as.integer(DATE),
      PRCP    = as.numeric(PRCP),
      
      year    = as.integer(substr(DATE, 1, 4))
    )
})

```
```{r}
station2county <- stations_with_county %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(STATION, GEOID)
```

```{r}
weather_all <- weather_all %>%
  left_join(station2county, by = "STATION") %>%
  filter(!is.na(GEOID))
```
```{r}
weather_summary <- weather_daily %>%
  mutate(
    year  = year(DATE),
    month = month(DATE),
    # compute daily GDD above 50°F
    gdd    = pmax(((TMAX + TMIN) / 2) - 50, 0)
  ) %>%
  filter(month %in% grow_months) %>%
  group_by(STATION, year) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_temp       = mean(TAVG, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_prcp      = sum(PRCP, na.rm = TRUE),
    prcp_days       = sum(DP01, na.rm = TRUE),
    heavy_prcp_days = sum(DP1X, na.rm = TRUE),
    hot_days        = sum(DX90, na.rm = TRUE),
    freeze_days     = sum(DT32, na.rm = TRUE),
    cdd_sum         = sum(CLDD, na.rm = TRUE),
    hdd_sum         = sum(HTDD, na.rm = TRUE),
    gdd_base50      = sum(gdd, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups         = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
wheat2 <- wheat %>%
  transmute(
    # zero-pad state and county ANSI codes
    state_fips  = str_pad(state_ansi, 2, pad = "0"),
    county_fips = str_pad(county_ansi, 3, pad = "0"),
    GEOID       = paste0(state_fips, county_fips),   # e.g. "01031"
    year        = as.integer(year),
    wheat_area  = as.numeric(Value)
  )
```

```{r}
df_mod <- inner_join(

)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(wesanderson)

br2 <- wes_palette("BottleRocket2")

# 2. plot with br2[2] for points, br2[4] for the line
ggplot(df_mod, aes(x = mean_prcp, y = wheat_area)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, color = br2[2]) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = br2[4]) +
  labs(
    title = "Wheat Area Harvested vs. Mean Annual Precipitation",
    x     = "Mean Annual Precipitation (mm)",
    y     = "Wheat Area Harvested (acres)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```
